intro: The EQ-Economic Study table combines sleek aesthetics with practical design, making it the ideal companion for hostel rooms or compact study spaces. Thoughtfully crafted for style and functionality.

features.title: Sleek, modern aesthetics
features.text: Minimalistic design with elegant finishes elevates the look of your study space while blending seamlessly into any decor.

features.title: Smart storage, always within reach
features.text: Stay organised effortlessly with a spacious drawer and an open shelf, ideal for storing all your bedtime essentials within easy reach.

features.title: Easily accessible file manager
features.text: A spacious metal file holder provides easy access to documents, books, and other essentials, keeping your workspace organised.

features.title: Two-level display for organization
features.text: A spacious metal drawer provides easy access to books, stationery, and other essentials, keeping your study area organised.

features.title: Robust and Durable Design
features.text: Built with a tubular steel structure and tested for durability, it withstands daily wear and tear with ease.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
